name: application-appointment-slot-card
title: Appointment Slot Card
description: Provider, appointment type, and time-slot card with reschedule/confirm actions, driven by a typed provider/slot prop contract.
useWhen: Presenting a single proposed or confirmed appointment slot with a provider and time before final booking.
The appointment type (video call, in-person, phone) should be visually distinguished from the provider identity.
Users need a clear reschedule-or-confirm decision point for one specific slot.
avoidWhen: You need to display a list of many appointment options at once — use the Availability Grid for slot selection instead.
The confirmation flow needs multiple steps (insurance, forms) — pair this card with a Stepper Wizard rather than a single card.
There is no provider concept (e.g. a generic calendar event) — a simpler event card is more appropriate.
responsiveBehavior: The card is a single fixed-width block with intrinsic sizing; the reschedule/confirm buttons sit side by side and remain full-width within their half of the row at any card width.
accessibility: The appointment type badge uses both a background tint and a text label so the type is never communicated by color alone.
The date/time row uses a decorative calendar icon (aria-hidden) with the schedule text itself carrying the actual meaning.
Reschedule and Confirm are both full-width, clearly labeled buttons rather than icon-only actions, avoiding ambiguity about which is primary.

variants.title: Appointment Slot Card
variants.description: Provider avatar/name/specialty header, an appointment-type badge, a date/time row, and reschedule/confirm-booking actions.
accessibility: The appointment-type badge pairs a tinted background with a text label, not color alone.

variants.title: Appointment Slot Card (Dark)
variants.description: Appointment card adapted for dark surfaces with the same provider-header, type-badge, and action structure.
accessibility: Provider name, badge, time text, and button labels must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
